title: Disability Compensation Dependency Releases: Amount Owed for Past Months
content:
**Amount.** The dependency release on a Disability Compensation award is the additions owed each month for the claims' dependents multiplied by the months it covers, and the product is rounded half up to the cent.

**The claims.** The claims are the award's most recent dependency claim — the one with the latest received date — together with any school-attendance claim received the same day.

**Additions owed each month.** The additions owed each month are one spouse addition for each spouse, one child addition for each child and one parent addition for each dependent parent, up to the parent maximum, recorded on those claims, at the rates of the award's own tier. A child is counted here at the child addition whether recorded as a minor child or as a school child. The parent additions are as many parent additions as the parent maximum when the claims record at least that many dependent parents, and one parent addition for each dependent parent recorded on them otherwise.

**Months covered.** The months a dependency release covers are the whole months elapsed from the claims' effective date to the issue date of the most recent monthly payment on the award.

**Effective date of the claims.** The claims' effective date is the latest date of marriage, birth or adoption recorded on the dependency claim when it was received no later than the dependency report window after that date, and the date it was received otherwise.

The rates used — the spouse addition, the child addition, the parent addition and the parent maximum of the award's tier — and the dependency report window are the product figures in the Disability Compensation schedules.

**Worked example (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating)).**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Most recent dependency claim received | 10 September 2025 |
| Latest marriage, birth or adoption date on it | Marriage on 14 June 2025 (88 days before receipt, within the 365-day window) |
| Claims' effective date | 14 June 2025 |
| Dependents recorded on the claims | One spouse and one child |
| Issue date of the most recent monthly payment | 1 March 2026 |
| Whole months from 14 June 2025 to 1 March 2026 | 8 |
| Additions owed each month | 110.15 plus 73.05, that is 183.20 |
| Dependency release | 183.20 multiplied by 8, that is 1465.60 |

**Effective-date variant (hypothetical).** Had the same claim been received on 15 June 2026, more than 365 days after the marriage, the claims' effective date would be 15 June 2026, the date it was received.
